content:
karen (Support): FYI customer in private VPC reporting 502/503s + huge tail latency since yesterday evening. They also see KMS access errors in app logs. Escalating for a security/network review.

jordan (Security): can you paste the customer's org id and the exact error lines? also: did they recently push firewall or route changes?

karen (Support): org=acme-corp, env=prod-vpc-7, last change ~2026-02-11 21:18 UTC (customer says they only changed a perimeter ACL). App logs:

karen (Support): "ERROR: KMS: AccessDenied for GenerateDataKey, attempt=1, retrying"

karen (Support): and higher-level app trace shows many retries then downstream 503s from our inference endpoint.

alex (eng-oncall): quick repro I ran from a bastion in a similar VPC:

alex (eng-oncall): ```
# test control plane reachability
curl -v --resolve control.redwood.internal:443:10.0.2.5 https://control.redwood.internal/health
* Connected to control.redwood.internal (10.0.2.5) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake... (hangs)
* Operation timed out after 30 seconds
curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30000 milliseconds
```

alex (eng-oncall): also tried a KMS endpoint test:

alex (eng-oncall): ```
openssl s_client -connect kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com:443 -servername kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
# hangs at TCP handshake
```

maria (eng-runtime): this reads like egress to AWS KMS (and possibly our control plane endpoints) is blocked. Private requires outbound 443 to specific endpoints. Minimal egress rules we recommend:

maria (eng-runtime): - Allow outbound TCP 443 to kms.*.amazonaws.com (region-specific)
maria (eng-runtime): - Allow outbound TCP 443 to control.redwood.internal (or the customer's control-plane IPs we provisioned)
maria (eng-runtime): - DNS (UDP 53) to resolver
maria (eng-runtime): - NTP (UDP 123)

sanjay (eng-infra): +1 on flow logs + packet capture. Please enable VPC Flow Logs to a S3/CloudWatch role and collect tcpdump on the node to see TCP resets.

sanjay (eng-infra): tcpdump snippet I asked them to run (one-liner):

sanjay (eng-infra): ```
sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 host kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com and port 443 -c 200 -w /tmp/kms-test.pcap
```

karen (Support): customer returned partial pcap, shows many SYNs but no SYN-ACKs. Also CloudTrail shows GenerateDataKey failures but no successful replays in audit logs.

jordan (Security): need to confirm whether their firewall silently drops egress or actively rejects (RST). If dropped, TLS handshake will hang and our SDK retries will pile up causing CPU and token churn.

maria (eng-runtime): that matches the symptom: repeated KMS HA fetch attempts block worker threads. When key loads time out, request latency skyrockets and tokens are retried/billed.

finance-bot: Note: support ticket 58213 flagged a billing spike for acme-corp due to repeated token generation calls between 2026-02-11T21:00Z and 2026-02-12T03:00Z.

karen (Support): customer also reports missing audit entries for a window. Jordan, are we seeing any audit retention issues on Private installations?

jordan (Security): default Private audit retention is 90 days. Missing entries likely due to their VPC ACLs preventing delivery to our audit ingestion endpoint. Check S3/CloudWatch connectivity for audit streaming.

sanjay (eng-infra): CloudTrail/ingest requires outbound 443 to logs.redwood.internal or S3 endpoints. If audits are streamed to their own S3, ensure PutObject/STS endpoints reachable.

karen (Support): customer is using HSM-backed keys. They said HSM gateway is on-prem and we call it via a proxy. Could the proxy be blocking some TLS ciphers causing handshake failures?

alex (eng-oncall): possible. Please check /var/log/redwood/keymanager.log on the node for TLS negotiation errors. Example stack I saw in the app:

alex (eng-oncall): "javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Remote host closed connection during handshake"

maria (eng-runtime): mitigation we can push immediately:

maria (eng-runtime): 1) Ask customer to open outbound 443 to kms endpoints + control plane
maria (eng-runtime): 2) Enable short-term local key cache (we can toggle via feature flag) so repeated KMS latency doesn't block inference threads
maria (eng-runtime): 3) Enable VPC Flow Logs and provide pcap as evidence for network team

karen (Support): customer approved temporary rule change. They opened egress to kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com and control plane IPs, latency improved within 8 minutes and 503s dropped to near zero :thumbsup: 

jordan (Security): good. Follow-ups:

jordan (Security): - add KB entry to Private onboarding docs for required egress rules
jordan (Security): - update security review checklist to ask about HSM proxy ciphers and audit sink connectivity
jordan (Security): - recommend customers enable audit buffering with local disk + retry to avoid data loss when outbound is briefly blocked

karen (Support): will create a customer-facing runbook and patch ticket. Assigning to eng-runtime for feature flag and eng-infra for KB changes.

sre-bot: Deployment started by maria for key-cache-feature-flag -> staging

maria (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a hotfix to enable local key cache for Private where HSM/KMS latency is causing tail latencies. ETA 4h.

sanjay (eng-infra): I'll add a KB article with exact SG/ACL examples and tcpdump troubleshooting steps.

karen (Support): thanks everyone. recording incident and closing ticket after follow-ups are done. tagging docs/KB action items.
